US.description: Includes federal income tax, FICA (Social Security and Medicare), and an estimated average state/local income tax for a single filer.

IN.description: Effective rate includes central government income tax, surcharge, and health & education cess under the New Tax Regime.

SG.description: Effective personal income tax rate for an $85k USD earner in Singapore. Excludes mandatory employee CPF contributions which are additional.

CH.description: Includes federal, cantonal, and municipal income taxes, plus mandatory social security contributions.

NL.description: Includes national income tax (Box 1) and social security contributions, after general and employment tax credits.

GB.description: Includes income tax and employee National Insurance contributions.

CA.description: Includes federal and provincial income taxes, plus mandatory social contributions (CPP/EI) for an $85k USD earner in Ontario.

AE.description: The UAE has no personal income tax for salaries and wages.

NO.description: Includes municipal, county, national income tax (trinnskatt), and national insurance contributions.

IE.description: Effective tax rate includes income tax, Universal Social Charge (USC), and Pay Related Social Insurance (PRSI) for a single earner.

LU.description: Includes progressive income tax and mandatory social security contributions.

AU.description: Includes federal income tax, including the Medicare levy.

QA.description: No personal income tax is levied on residents' earnings in Qatar.

BN.description: Brunei has no personal income tax, so the effective rate for an $85k USD earner is 0%.

MO.description: Effective rate based on Macao's Professional Tax, which features a progressive structure with generous allowances, leading to a relatively low overall tax burden for this income level.
